decisions.reason: The 1.27 mm pitch decision applies to the integrated-board ESP32 breakout; the main-board breakout is a distinct design and the source does not change its state.
Changing the integrated ESP32 breakout pitch does not alter the single-board architecture, functional consolidation, or functionality-preservation requirements.
The source establishes a breakout pitch but does not change the integrated board's cost goal, component-tier preference, connector-reduction policy, or sourcing exception.
The ESP32 pin-header pitch has no entailed effect on the selected AXP2101 architecture, required rails, charging behavior, or battery-efficiency goal.
A 1.27 mm pitch remains compatible with the existing through-hole connector-assembly requirement and does not change its type or coverage.
The breakout pitch does not change the required current-measurement capability or the conditional omission of a separate INA device.
The ESP32 breakout pitch does not alter any display-backlight circuit, supply, switching, PWM, or component requirement.
The source does not change the quantity, connector type, interface, or purpose of the display light-sensor port.
The source concerns the integrated-board ESP32 breakout, not the main-board JST and USB-C connector inventory or its documented connector pitches.
The sensor-board connector topology and its connector-specific pitches are independent of the integrated-board ESP32 pin-header pitch.
The integrated ESP32 header-pitch correction has no entailed effect on the power-board AXP2101 topology or thermal-pad requirements.
The integrated-board ESP32 breakout pitch does not affect the separate LED board's LED count, model, package, or related part attributes.
